about_the_game:
This DLC contains the "Support Unit cloak skin" for Farsiders' protagonist Cassie. The cosmetic was created specially for those who supported us on Kickstarter. For those eligible, you can use the key sent to you via email to redeem this special cloak skin.
You can change Cassie's cloak at the start menu before starting the game.

Once again, thank you for supporting Farsiders!
